title.value: A Constraint Programming Approach to Weighted Isomorphic Mapping of Fragment-based Shape Signatures
title.justification: The title provided is directly from the paper and summarizes the main approach and topic of the research.
title.quote: A Constraint Programming Approach to Weighted Isomorphic Mapping of Fragment-based Shape Signatures

extractions.description: This paper presents a constraint programming approach to solving the weighted isomorphic mapping problem in fragment-based shape signatures for computer-aided drug design. The work is centered around improving methods to map chemical structure fragments in large databases efficiently without involving the whole chemical structure, using constraint solvers to optimize and diversify solution paths.
